m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: An incantation to dispel a Goblin portal? That's not exactly the sort of spell we let new students meddle with!
That's in the restricted collection. I can only release the incantation with the permission of the Headmistress.
Speak to Headmistress Crisp and return to me with a permission slip. It's but a formality, but rules are rules.
Excellent! I took the liberty of copying the incantation you need while you were speaking with Headmistress Crisp.
What's this? I send you to help Captain O'Hare and the next I hear from you, you're talking about dispelling Goblin portals?
Very well, then. I'm getting a clearer picture of how Ambrose runs his school, and believe me, it's not a pretty picture.
Take this back to Chatterly, and tell him he's to help you to the best of his abilities. Is that all?
Wonderful! I hope it wasn't any trouble!
Bad news! I looked at my spellbook and I realize I have the ingredients for the ritual, but I don't have the incantation!
They should have a copy of it at the library here in Pigswick Academy. Could you go to the library and get it?
I think the librarian is named Hugo Chatterly. Tell him it's of utmost importance!
Go to the library and speak to Hugo Chatterly. He should provide us with the incantation we need.
